an5.176:1.1: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an5.176:2.2: na kho gahapati tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā
an5.176:2.5: kinti mayaṃ kālena kālaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja vihareyyāmāti
an5.176:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.176:3.5: na kho gahapati tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā
an5.176:3.8: kinti mayaṃ kālena kālaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja vihareyyāmāti
an5.176:3.10: yasmiṃ bhante samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati pañcassa ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na honti

an5.176:3.13: yampissa akusalupasañhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ tampissa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti
